title: How to reduce typing fatigue during a working day
summary: A practical way to reduce keyboard-heavy work: identify repetitive tasks, use dictation selectively, review your setup, and keep breaks in the day.
body_markdown:
## Review the workstation and activation method


OSHA’s workstation guidance calls for a keyboard position that lets the shoulders relax and the wrists stay aligned with the forearms. It also encourages task variation and short pauses. Its evaluation checklist can help you identify something concrete to change with your employer or an ergonomics specialist.\[2\]\[3\]


Check how your speech tool starts and stops recording. A shortcut you must hold for an entire paragraph may not fit your needs. VoiceOS provides a hands-free dictation shortcut that starts and stops on separate presses. Confirm your configured shortcut in the app and test stopping before using it for a long passage. This is an input option, not a claim that it treats symptoms.


Speech has constraints too. Shared rooms, private information, and the effort of talking can make some sessions unsuitable. Keep other input methods available and do not turn a tool experiment into a demand to speak continuously.


Sources & further reading:


[Computer Workstations: Keyboards](https://www.osha.gov/etools/computer-workstations/components/keyboards) ·
